settings.title: Settings
settings.eula_helper: The server only starts after accepting the Minecraft End User License Agreement: https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA
settings.server_type_helper: Paper is recommended: fast, plugin support, required for Bedrock. Vanilla is Mojang's unmodified server, Fabric runs mods.
settings.version_helper: LATEST installs the newest release at every server start; a fixed version such as 1.21.8 keeps the world on that version until you change it. Downgrades are not supported by Minecraft.
settings.memory_mb_helper: Memory for the server JVM. 2048 MB is fine for a handful of players; Paper with plugins or many players needs more. Must leave enough memory for the node.
settings.game_port_helper: Published on all node addresses and opened on the node firewall. Default 25565.
settings.timezone_helper: TZ database name; used for the server log timestamps.
settings.motd_helper: Shown in the server list of the clients.
settings.online_mode_helper: Verify players against Mojang's authentication servers (recommended). Switch off only for offline/LAN servers — anyone can then join under any name.
settings.seed_helper: Only used when the world is created; leave empty for a random world.
settings.whitelist_helper: One player name per line. Empty: everybody may join. The list is synchronised at every server start.
settings.ops_helper: One player name per line; operators may run all server commands.
settings.bedrock_helper: Lets Bedrock clients (phones, consoles, Windows 10/11 app) join the Java server. Paper only; the latest Geyser/Floodgate builds are downloaded from GeyserMC at every start.
settings.extra_env_helper: KEY=VALUE per line, passed to the itzg/minecraft-server image after the generated settings (see its documentation for the full list). Variables managed by this page cannot be overridden.
settings.status_starting: Container running, server still starting or not reachable
settings.connect_desc: Java Edition: {java} — Bedrock: {bedrock}. Use the node's public name or IP; forward the port(s) on your router for players outside the LAN.
settings.command_helper: Sent to the running server via RCON, e.g. list, say Hello, whitelist add Steve, op Alex, save-all, time set day.
settings.eula_required: The Minecraft EULA must be accepted
settings.port_in_use: Port already in use on this node
settings.bedrock_requires_paper: Bedrock support requires the Paper server type
settings.memory_too_large: Heap larger than the node can provide
settings.reserved_variable: Variable is managed by the settings page
settings.invalid_player_name: Player names: 3–16 letters, digits or underscore
settings.invalid_extra_env: Entries must look like KEY=VALUE (uppercase key)
settings.invalid_version: Version must be LATEST, SNAPSHOT or a version number
